scenarios.name: Incomplete Check run refused
scenarios.reason: CHK refuses a start without employeeId (400 CHK-400-START-INCOMPLETE, refusals group) before it calls createCheckRun; no public path hands RPT a blank value

scenarios.name: AWAITING_DOCUMENTS with fetch mode path refused
scenarios.reason: CHK derives the initial status from the version's fetch mode (path -> RUNNING); step 2 is a direct INSERT into the service schema

scenarios.name: Manual Check starting RUNNING refused
scenarios.reason: CHK always starts a manual Check AWAITING_DOCUMENTS

scenarios.name: Mark RUNNING again keeps the first running time
scenarios.reason: CHK calls markRunning once per Check (at the confirmation); a second confirmation is refused by CHK (409 CHK-409) before RPT

scenarios.name: Ended Check cannot be marked RUNNING
scenarios.reason: a confirmation of an ended Check is refused by CHK (409 CHK-409-CHECK-NOT-AWAITING-DOCUMENTS) before markRunning

scenarios.name: Check not RUNNING cannot be completed
scenarios.reason: CHK completes only the Check its pipeline runs

scenarios.name: Unknown Check on the result port
scenarios.reason: CHK fails only Checks it created; no public path names Check 999

scenarios.name: Report stored whole or not at all
scenarios.reason: the outcome `PASSED` cannot reach RPT: CHK's structured output admits SATISFIED / NOT_SATISFIED / UNDETERMINED only (MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID before RPT)

scenarios.name: Database failure while storing a report leaves nothing stored
scenarios.reason: needs a fault injected on the INSERT of the second Finding — not producible through the API

scenarios.name: Metadata disagreeing with the Check run refused
scenarios.reason: CHK builds the metadata from the stored run

scenarios.name: COMPLIANT refused unless every finding is SATISFIED
scenarios.reason: CHK's Overall Status rule never hands COMPLIANT with a NOT_SATISFIED finding (a scripted NOT_SATISFIED gives NOT_COMPLIANT, TC-RPT-029)

scenarios.name: Code outside its closed list refused
scenarios.reason: CHK passes only its own closed codes; steps 2-3 are direct writes to the service schema

scenarios.name: Finding without evidence refused
scenarios.reason: CHK records a finding without evidence as UNDETERMINED with evidence 'NONE' (REQ-CHK-040) before RPT

scenarios.name: UNREADABLE document without a reason refused
scenarios.reason: DOC always gives an UNREADABLE outcome its reason; step 2 is a direct INSERT

scenarios.name: Ended report never changes
scenarios.reason: CHK completes a Check once; no public path calls completeCheck again

scenarios.name: Incomplete failure refused
scenarios.reason: CHK always gives a failure its detail

scenarios.name: One Check read for the Check Engine
scenarios.reason: getCheck's result is handed to CHK in-process only; API-RPT-001 is a different operation (its fields are asserted by TC-RPT-001)

scenarios.name: Approval API flag on a rejection refused
scenarios.reason: INT hands approvalApiExecuted=false for every REJECTED decision (TC-INT-013); step 2 is a direct UPDATE

scenarios.name: Unfinished Check never purged
scenarios.reason: needs a Check unfinished for longer than the retention period: the shortest period is 1 whole day and every restart (a purge-mode change) ends unfinished Checks INTERRUPTED; the rows cannot be aged without direct DB writes

scenarios.name: Hand-over with an undeclared field cannot reach the store
scenarios.reason: structural (reflection + architecture rule over the value types) — an in-process test the no-JUnit policy excludes; no API reaches it

scenarios.name: The upload carries the Check's own service version
scenarios.reason: making version 2 current needs a load run, which happens only at an instance start, and every start ends all unfinished Checks INTERRUPTED (REQ-CHK-055, a global recovery): no Check can await uploads on version 1 while version 2 is current
